# orca run

Every `orca run` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca run show <run> [--group <group>]`

one run: its entry in the group view, the newest 10 activity rows, the evidence summary

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id
- `--group <group>`: the run's group (default: found from the groups the summary lists)

## `orca run activity <run>`

a run's newest 200 activity rows, newest first

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id

## `orca run evidence <run>`

a run's evidence manifest

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id

## `orca run results <run>`

a run's saved results

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id

## `orca run eligibility <run>`

whether a run's saved result can be verified instead of re-run

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<run>`: a run id
